sentences.en: In corners of media, including our corner, we’ve managed to really hold the line on this, but if you look at a lot of social video in particular and platforms like TikTok, totally undisclosed advertising is everywhere and it really distorts how people see the world.
sentences.zh: 在媒体的各个角落，包括我们的角落，我们已经成功地坚守了这一点，但如果你看一下很多社交视频，特别是 TikTok 等平台，就会发现完全未公开的广告无处不在，它确实扭曲了人们看待世界的方式。

sentences.en: Just in terms of people’s judgment about what’s working, what’s real, what’s not real.
sentences.zh: 就人们对什么是有效的、什么是真实的、什么是不真实的判断而言。

blocks.html_en: I think about this a lot in the AI space actually, because there are so many anecdotes out there or videos of people doing incredibly cool things with this tool or that tool, and you just never really know. It’s just hard to know what’s marketing and what’s not, what’s just literally paid for and what’s not. We are doing a project that I’m very excited about called the Semafor Innovation Atlas. It’s just literally trying to report, “Here are some cool particularly public sector AI projects that are real.” Because there’s so much out there that’s just unreal but that tells a good story, which is in a way the job of marketing.

sentences.en: I think about this a lot in the AI space actually, because there are so many anecdotes out there or videos of people doing incredibly cool things with this tool or that tool, and you just never really know.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我在人工智能领域思考了很多这个问题，因为有很多轶事或视频显示人们用这个或那个工具做了非常酷的事情，但你永远不知道。

sentences.en: It’s just hard to know what’s marketing and what’s not, what’s just literally paid for and what’s not.
sentences.zh: 很难知道什么是营销，什么不是，什么是真正付费的，什么不是。

sentences.en: We are doing a project that I’m very excited about called the Semafor Innovation Atlas.
sentences.zh: 我们正在做一个令我非常兴奋的项目，名为 Semafor 创新地图集。

sentences.en: It’s just literally trying to report, “Here are some cool particularly public sector AI projects that are real.”
sentences.zh: 它只是从字面上试图报告，“这里有一些很酷的、特别是真实的公共部门人工智能项目。”

sentences.en: Because there’s so much out there that’s just unreal but that tells a good story, which is in a way the job of marketing.
sentences.zh: 因为有太多不真实的东西，但却讲述了一个好故事，这在某种程度上是营销的工作。

blocks.html_en: I had a partner at a very, very large consulting firm tell me they had done hundreds of AI deployments and less than two dozen had yielded positive ROI. I said, “Can you just tell me that on the record?” And he said, “Absolutely not. We want hundreds more.”

sentences.en: I had a partner at a very, very large consulting firm tell me they had done hundreds of AI deployments and less than two dozen had yielded positive ROI.
sentences.zh: 我的一位非常非常大的咨询公司的合作伙伴告诉我，他们已经完成了数百次人工智能部署，但只有不到两打取得了积极的投资回报率。

sentences.en: I said, “Can you just tell me that on the record?”
sentences.zh: 我说：“你能记录下来告诉我吗？”

sentences.en: And he said, “Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 他说：“绝对不是。

sentences.en: We want hundreds more.”
sentences.zh: 我们还想要数百个。”

blocks.html_en: We’re in that moment where everything feels marketing, everything feels corrupt. The thing I’m just pushing at is the audience, their base assumption, regardless of how elite the audience is, is that everything is corrupt. I find the higher up we go, the assumption that things can be bought and paid for increases.

sentences.en: We’re in that moment where everything feels marketing, everything feels corrupt.
sentences.zh: 我们正处在一个一切都感觉是营销、一切都感觉腐败的时刻。

sentences.en: The thing I’m just pushing at is the audience, their base assumption, regardless of how elite the audience is, is that everything is corrupt.
sentences.zh: 我只是向观众推销，他们的基本假设是，无论观众多么精英，一切都是腐败的。

sentences.en: I find the higher up we go, the assumption that things can be bought and paid for increases.
sentences.zh: 我发现我们走得越高，可以购买和支付东西的假设就会增加。

blocks.html_en: We live in a very populist moment, in this widespread belief that everything is corrupt. It just diffuses through society and it’s partly justified. It’s partly not. My favorite example of this is the congressional stock trading thing, where there’s been a lot of research. There are, I’m sure, corrupt Congress people front-running stocks. It’s never been a big problem and there’s no study showing that it’s widespread.

sentences.en: We live in a very populist moment, in this widespread belief that everything is corrupt.
sentences.zh: 我们生活在一个非常民粹主义的时代，人们普遍相信一切都是腐败的。

sentences.en: It just diffuses through society and it’s partly justified.
sentences.zh: 它只是在社会中传播，而且在一定程度上是合理的。

sentences.en: It’s partly not.
sentences.zh: 部分不是。

sentences.en: My favorite example of this is the congressional stock trading thing, where there’s been a lot of research.
sentences.zh: 我最喜欢的例子是国会股票交易，对此进行了大量研究。

sentences.en: There are, I’m sure, corrupt Congress people front-running stocks.
sentences.zh: 我确信，腐败的国会议员在抢先炒股。

sentences.en: It’s never been a big problem and there’s no study showing that it’s widespread.
sentences.zh: 这从来都不是一个大问题，也没有研究表明它很普遍。

blocks.html_en: To try to disabuse people of this, they passed a law several years ago saying that members of Congress have to disclose their stock trades. And now there are all these accounts. There’s 400 whatever members of Congress, some of them are winning, some of them are losing. If you only look at the ones who are doing well, you can tell a story about widespread corruption.

sentences.en: To try to disabuse people of this, they passed a law several years ago saying that members of Congress have to disclose their stock trades.
sentences.zh: 为了消除人们的误解，他们几年前通过了一项法律，规定国会议员必须披露他们的股票交易。

sentences.en: And now there are all these accounts.
sentences.zh: 现在所有这些账户都有了。

sentences.en: There’s 400 whatever members of Congress, some of them are winning, some of them are losing.
sentences.zh: 国会有 400 名议员，有些人获胜，有些人失败。

sentences.en: If you only look at the ones who are doing well, you can tell a story about widespread corruption.
sentences.zh: 如果你只看那些表现好的人，你就可以讲述一个普遍存在的腐败的故事。

blocks.html_en: Now, everyone believes it’s incredibly corrupt as a result of a transparency measure that actually showed it wasn’t. We’re in a moment where there’s this deeply baked-in sense that every institution is corrupt. We try by being really transparent and really direct and, by not compromising on this stuff, sending a message to counter that. But you’re swimming against a big cultural tide right now.

sentences.en: Now, everyone believes it’s incredibly corrupt as a result of a transparency measure that actually showed it wasn’t.
sentences.zh: 现在，每个人都认为它非常腐败，因为透明度措施实际上表明事实并非如此。

sentences.en: We’re in a moment where there’s this deeply baked-in sense that every institution is corrupt.
sentences.zh: 我们正处于一个根深蒂固的感觉：每个机构都腐败。

sentences.en: We try by being really transparent and really direct and, by not compromising on this stuff, sending a message to counter that.
sentences.zh: 我们尝试做到真正透明和直接，并且在这些事情上不妥协，发送信息来反击这一点。

sentences.en: But you’re swimming against a big cultural tide right now.
sentences.zh: 但你现在正在逆流而上的文化大潮。

blocks.html_en: For us, a big part of the marketing of our events and the way we make them good is that it’s going to be a festival of news, we’re going to ask real questions, it’s going to be exciting. Justin at some point I think called Semafor World Economy “Davos with follow-up questions.”

sentences.en: For us, a big part of the marketing of our events and the way we make them good is that it’s going to be a festival of news, we’re going to ask real questions, it’s going to be exciting.
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，活动营销的一个重要部分以及我们做好活动的方式是，这将是一个新闻节，我们将提出真正的问题，这将是令人兴奋的。

sentences.en: Justin at some point I think called Semafor World Economy “Davos with follow-up questions.”
sentences.zh: 我认为贾斯汀曾将 Semafor 世界经济称为“有后续问题的达沃斯”。

blocks.html_en: That’s pretty good.

sentences.en: That’s pretty good.
sentences.zh: 那很好。

blocks.html_en: That to me is like you guys saying, “We don’t take freebies in reviewing gadgets.” That’s a huge selling point for you. You got to really lean into that, not away from it.

sentences.en: That to me is like you guys saying, “We don’t take freebies in reviewing gadgets.”
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这就像你们说的：“我们在评论小工具时不会接受免费赠品。”

sentences.en: That’s a huge selling point for you.
sentences.zh: 这对你来说是一个巨大的卖点。

sentences.en: You got to really lean into that, not away from it.
sentences.zh: 你必须真正投入其中，而不是远离它。

blocks.html_en: The thing that gets me now, the reason I think we can market it, is that if this was 10 years ago saying, “The Verge has an ethics policy,” all of my competitors would say, “So do we.” I think Wired is doing great reporting.

sentences.en: The thing that gets me now, the reason I think we can market it, is that if this was 10 years ago saying, “The Verge has an ethics policy,” all of my competitors would say, “So do we.”
sentences.zh: 现在让我感到困惑的是，我认为我们可以推销它的原因是，如果这是 10 年前说的，“The Verge 有道德政策”，我所有的竞争对手都会说，“我们也是。”

sentences.en: I think Wired is doing great reporting.
sentences.zh: 我认为《连线》的报道做得很好。

blocks.html_en: A lot of the way they market their great reporting is they just say out loud, “Look at all this reporting, we do it. Buy our subscription.” It’s totally effective. They’ve cracked some code there by just saying out loud that they do the reporting, people will pay for it.

sentences.en: A lot of the way they market their great reporting is they just say out loud, “Look at all this reporting, we do it.
sentences.zh: 他们营销精彩报道的很多方式就是大声说：“看看这些报道，我们就是这么做的。

sentences.en: Buy our subscription.”
sentences.zh: 购买我们的订阅。”

sentences.en: It’s totally effective.
sentences.zh: 这是完全有效的。

sentences.en: They’ve cracked some code there by just saying out loud that they do the reporting, people will pay for it.
sentences.zh: 他们只要大声说他们做了报道，人们就会为此付费，从而破解了一些密码。

blocks.html_en: Turns out people like journalism.

sentences.en: Turns out people like journalism.
sentences.zh: 事实证明人们喜欢新闻业。

blocks.html_en: I think that’s very smart. What has occurred to me in all of that is particularly our youngest audience does not know. They did not come up the same way. The water they’ve been swimming in their entire lives is social media, integrated brand campaigns by creators, and a feed that is increasingly fake and bought and paid for. I’m not sure about us showing up and saying, “There’s an old way of doing this.”

sentences.en: I think that’s very smart.
sentences.zh: 我认为这非常聪明。

sentences.en: What has occurred to me in all of that is particularly our youngest audience does not know.
sentences.zh: 我所经历的这一切尤其是我们最年轻的观众不知道的。

sentences.en: They did not come up the same way.
sentences.zh: 他们没有以同样的方式出现。

sentences.en: The water they’ve been swimming in their entire lives is social media, integrated brand campaigns by creators, and a feed that is increasingly fake and bought and paid for.
sentences.zh: 他们一生都在游泳的水是社交媒体、创作者的综合品牌活动以及越来越假的、购买和付费的饲料。

sentences.en: I’m not sure about us showing up and saying, “There’s an old way of doing this.”
sentences.zh: 我不确定我们是否会出现并说：“有一种古老的方法可以做到这一点。”

blocks.html_en: See, I disagree. People don’t want to be lied to and don’t want to be fed slop. We’re headed for some kind of reckoning like the big payola scandals in the radio industry.

sentences.en: See, I disagree.
sentences.zh: 你看，我不同意。

sentences.en: People don’t want to be lied to and don’t want to be fed slop.
sentences.zh: 人们不想被欺骗，也不想被喂屎。

sentences.en: We’re headed for some kind of reckoning like the big payola scandals in the radio industry.
sentences.zh: 我们即将面临某种清算，例如广播行业的重大薪资丑闻。

blocks.html_en: Everybody inside the radio industry knew and it was a totally open secret that the way you got your song on the radio is you pay off the DJ, but it turned out the audience was not in on the joke. So when Congress held hearings into it totally blew up the industry and upended everything.

sentences.en: Everybody inside the radio industry knew and it was a totally open secret that the way you got your song on the radio is you pay off the DJ, but it turned out the audience was not in on the joke.
sentences.zh: 广播行业内的每个人都知道，这是一个完全公开的秘密，你在广播中播放歌曲的方式就是付钱给 DJ，但事实证明，观众并没有参与这个笑话。

sentences.en: So when Congress held hearings into it totally blew up the industry and upended everything.
sentences.zh: 因此，当国会就此举行听证会时，整个行业彻底崩溃并颠覆了一切。

blocks.html_en: Particularly with political influencer marketing, people hate that. You’ve got to think Congress is going to come in and crack down on it. I’m actually optimistic about that. Adam Schiff just recently introduced a bill on it. That probably won’t be the one, but everybody hates this. The idea that your favorite influencer is being bribed by some politician to lie to you, people do not like that.

sentences.en: Particularly with political influencer marketing, people hate that.
sentences.zh: 人们讨厌这一点，尤其是政治影响力营销。

sentences.en: You’ve got to think Congress is going to come in and crack down on it.
sentences.zh: 你必须认为国会会介入并严厉打击它。

sentences.en: I’m actually optimistic about that.
sentences.zh: 我其实对此很乐观。

sentences.en: Adam Schiff just recently introduced a bill on it.
sentences.zh: 亚当·希夫最近刚刚就此提出了一项法案。

sentences.en: That probably won’t be the one, but everybody hates this.
sentences.zh: 这可能不是那个，但每个人都讨厌这个。

sentences.en: The idea that your favorite influencer is being bribed by some politician to lie to you, people do not like that.
sentences.zh: 如果你最喜欢的有影响力的人被某些政客贿赂来对你撒谎，人们不喜欢这样。

blocks.html_en: That disclosure, which is mostly in effect or somewhat in effect with big brand marketing, if PepsiCo buys an ad, they’re going to disclose it. There’s a lot of shady stuff happening around the margins. And then politics, because there’s this chasm between the Federal Elections Commission, which sort of collapsed, and the FTC, which regulates other advertising. There’s all this undisclosed and undisclosable political advertising. I just do not think people like that. That’s going to wind up having to be regulated. It makes people angry. It makes you angry.

sentences.en: That disclosure, which is mostly in effect or somewhat in effect with big brand marketing, if PepsiCo buys an ad, they’re going to disclose it.
sentences.zh: 这种披露主要对大品牌营销有效或在某种程度上有效，如果百事公司购买广告，他们就会披露它。

sentences.en: There’s a lot of shady stuff happening around the margins.
sentences.zh: 边缘地区发生了很多阴暗的事情。

sentences.en: And then politics, because there’s this chasm between the Federal Elections Commission, which sort of collapsed, and the FTC, which regulates other advertising.
sentences.zh: 然后是政治，因为联邦选举委员会（已经崩溃）和联邦贸易委员会（监管其他广告）之间存在分歧。

sentences.en: There’s all this undisclosed and undisclosable political advertising.
sentences.zh: 有所有这些未公开和不可公开的政治广告。

sentences.en: I just do not think people like that.
sentences.zh: 我只是不认为人们喜欢那样。

sentences.en: That’s going to wind up having to be regulated.
sentences.zh: 这最终将不得不受到监管。

sentences.en: It makes people angry.
sentences.zh: 这让人生气。

sentences.en: It makes you angry.
sentences.zh: 这会让你生气。

blocks.html_en: I’m curious about this. There was a recent story, I think it was Politico, saying all of the young staffers on the right have no idea how to do anything, because they’re all comms people. They’re all influencers and there’s a talent shortage.

sentences.en: I’m curious about this.
sentences.zh: 我对此很好奇。

sentences.en: There was a recent story, I think it was Politico, saying all of the young staffers on the right have no idea how to do anything, because they’re all comms people.
sentences.zh: 最近有一个报道，我想是《Politico》，说所有右翼的年轻工作人员都不知道如何做任何事情，因为他们都是通讯人员。

sentences.en: They’re all influencers and there’s a talent shortage.
sentences.zh: 他们都是有影响力的人，但人才短缺。

blocks.html_en: I think Madison Cawthorn was the bellwether. He came into office and he said, “I’ve got more comms people than policy people.” And then it very quickly became clear that wasn’t going to be great. But now that’s the norm that we’re all just tweeting policy into existence. We’re going to stop the Iran war with tweets. It’s a real thing that happens once a week in this country.

sentences.en: I think Madison Cawthorn was the bellwether.
sentences.zh: 我认为麦迪逊考索恩是领头羊。

sentences.en: He came into office and he said, “I’ve got more comms people than policy people.”
sentences.zh: 他上任后说：“我的通讯人员比政策人员还多。”

sentences.en: And then it very quickly became clear that wasn’t going to be great.
sentences.zh: 但很快我们就发现这不会太好。

sentences.en: But now that’s the norm that we’re all just tweeting policy into existence.
sentences.zh: 但现在我们都只是在推特上发布政策，这已经成为常态。

sentences.en: We’re going to stop the Iran war with tweets.
sentences.zh: 我们将通过推文停止伊朗战争。

sentences.en: It’s a real thing that happens once a week in this country.
sentences.zh: 这是这个国家每周都会发生一次的真实事件。

blocks.html_en: There’s something there that’s broken. Political influence operations, maybe we hate when they’re paid for, but they are politics now. And they’re part of the feed in a very real way.

sentences.en: There’s something there that’s broken.
sentences.zh: 那里有东西坏了。

sentences.en: Political influence operations, maybe we hate when they’re paid for, but they are politics now.
sentences.zh: 政治影响力行动，也许我们讨厌当他们付钱的时候，但他们现在是政治。

sentences.en: And they’re part of the feed in a very real way.
sentences.zh: 它们以非常真实的方式成为提要的一部分。

blocks.html_en: Sometimes in really damaging ways, this administration is incredibly responsive to social media. A story goes viral on Twitter and somebody gets their immigration status pulled — I just read a piece from a woman who’s in ICE holding because there was a sort of misleading campaign saying her husband’s mother had been a translator for the Iranians in the ‘70s, and so she’s now in an ICE holding cell. The administration acted because this went viral on social media.

sentences.en: Sometimes in really damaging ways, this administration is incredibly responsive to social media.
sentences.zh: 有时，本届政府对社交媒体的反应令人难以置信，这确实具有破坏性。

sentences.en: A story goes viral on Twitter and somebody gets their immigration status pulled — I just read a piece from a woman who’s in ICE holding because there was a sort of misleading campaign saying her husband’s mother had been a translator for the Iranians in the ‘70s, and so she’s now in an ICE holding cell.
sentences.zh: 一个故事在推特上疯传，有人的移民身份被取消——我刚刚读到了一位被 ICE 关押的女性的文章，因为有一种误导性的活动称她丈夫的母亲在 70 年代曾是伊朗人的翻译，所以她现在被关在 ICE 的牢房里。

sentences.en: The administration acted because this went viral on social media.
sentences.zh: 政府采取行动是因为这件事在社交媒体上疯传。

blocks.html_en: There’s always been a very intense relationship between the media and the politicians. The New York Times publishes a story and then Chuck Schumer the next day introduces a piece of legislation, which is the oldest trick in the book.

sentences.en: There’s always been a very intense relationship between the media and the politicians.
sentences.zh: 媒体和政界人士之间一直有着非常密切的关系。

sentences.en: The New York Times publishes a story and then Chuck Schumer the next day introduces a piece of legislation, which is the oldest trick in the book.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》发表了一篇报道，然后查克·舒默第二天就提出了一项立法，这是书中最古老的把戏。

blocks.html_en: Actually, it’s not been my experience that Republican staffers in Washington are incompetent. I live in New York and often go to Washington, and I’m in Washington a lot. People in my liberal Brooklyn neighborhood will say, “God, it must be so horrible to deal with those Trump people.” The reality is actually they’re incredibly polite and responsive.

sentences.en: Actually, it’s not been my experience that Republican staffers in Washington are incompetent.
sentences.zh: 事实上，根据我的经验，华盛顿的共和党工作人员不称职。

sentences.en: I live in New York and often go to Washington, and I’m in Washington a lot.
sentences.zh: 我住在纽约，经常去华盛顿，而且我经常在华盛顿。

sentences.en: People in my liberal Brooklyn neighborhood will say, “God, it must be so horrible to deal with those Trump people.”
sentences.zh: 我所在的布鲁克林自由派社区的人们会说：“天啊，和那些特朗普人打交道一定太可怕了。”

sentences.en: The reality is actually they’re incredibly polite and responsive.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们非常有礼貌且反应灵敏。

blocks.html_en: It was a nightmare often to deal with the Biden people, because Democrats think that journalists work for them. That writing something independent is an act of betrayal. I suppose Republicans have either appropriate or lower expectations. That’s sort of always been true.

sentences.en: It was a nightmare often to deal with the Biden people, because Democrats think that journalists work for them.
sentences.zh: 与拜登的人打交道常常是一场噩梦，因为民主党人认为记者为他们工作。

sentences.en: That writing something independent is an act of betrayal.
sentences.zh: 写一些独立的东西是一种背叛的行为。

sentences.en: I suppose Republicans have either appropriate or lower expectations.
sentences.zh: 我认为共和党人的期望要么适当，要么较低。

sentences.en: That’s sort of always been true.
sentences.zh: 这一直都是事实。

blocks.html_en: Communication has always been a pretty important part of politics, but there’s a way in which the disorganization of this administration in particular just means that they’re totally reactive to random pieces of media that somebody plays Donald Trump on an iPad. That is really different.

sentences.en: Communication has always been a pretty important part of politics, but there’s a way in which the disorganization of this administration in particular just means that they’re totally reactive to random pieces of media that somebody plays Donald Trump on an iPad.
sentences.zh: 沟通一直是政治中非常重要的一部分，但在某种程度上，本届政府的组织混乱意味着他们对有人在 iPad 上播放唐纳德·特朗普的随机媒体完全做出反应。

sentences.en: That is really different.
sentences.zh: 这确实是不同的。

blocks.html_en: I just see that we’re going to tweet policy into reality as a feature of this administration. There’s not a lot of rigor under that policy often.

sentences.en: I just see that we’re going to tweet policy into reality as a feature of this administration.
sentences.zh: 我只是看到我们将在推特上将政策变为现实，作为本届政府的一个特色。

sentences.en: There’s not a lot of rigor under that policy often.
sentences.zh: 该政策通常并不严格。

blocks.html_en: Or often somebody else just tweets something and it goes viral. This was the story of DOGE. Musk was just seeing tweets and making policy based on it.

sentences.en: Or often somebody else just tweets something and it goes viral.
sentences.zh: 或者经常有人只是在推特上发了一些东西，然后它就被病毒式传播了。

sentences.en: This was the story of DOGE.
sentences.zh: 这就是DOGE的故事。

sentences.en: Musk was just seeing tweets and making policy based on it.
sentences.zh: 马斯克只是看到推文并据此制定政策。

blocks.html_en: Do you think that has come to an end? We’re saying people hate these political influence operations, that probably they will get regulated in some way because both sides hate the idea that all the influencers are getting paid by politicians.

sentences.en: Do you think that has come to an end?
sentences.zh: 你认为事情已经结束了吗？

sentences.en: We’re saying people hate these political influence operations, that probably they will get regulated in some way because both sides hate the idea that all the influencers are getting paid by politicians.
sentences.zh: 我们说人们讨厌这些政治影响力运作，他们可能会以某种方式受到监管，因为双方都讨厌所有有影响力的人都从政客那里得到报酬的想法。

blocks.html_en: No, right now we’re in the worst part of it. Although you’ve seen a federal government that had had a lot of momentum and ability to execute things, it lost all of that. At the White House, there’s much less able to do anything right now, so there’s less happening.

sentences.en: No, right now we’re in the worst part of it.
sentences.zh: 不，现在我们正处于最糟糕的阶段。

sentences.en: Although you’ve seen a federal government that had had a lot of momentum and ability to execute things, it lost all of that.
sentences.zh: 尽管你看到联邦政府拥有很大的动力和执行能力，但它失去了所有这些。

sentences.en: At the White House, there’s much less able to do anything right now, so there’s less happening.
sentences.zh: 在白宫，现在能做的事情要少得多，所以发生的事情也少了。

blocks.html_en: This is where I wanted to wrap up. It’s going to break somehow. There’s some kind of reckoning coming where people want the truth. People don’t trust the tech companies. The antipathy towards AI in particular is high, but the tech companies and a bunch of billionaires own all our distribution in very significant and serious ways. Something is going to happen. The audiences are going to change in some way. There will be some reaction somehow. Do you have a view of that?

sentences.en: This is where I wanted to wrap up.
sentences.zh: 这就是我想结束的地方。

sentences.en: It’s going to break somehow.
sentences.zh: 它会以某种方式破裂。

sentences.en: There’s some kind of reckoning coming where people want the truth.
sentences.zh: 当人们想要了解真相时，就会有某种清算。

sentences.en: People don’t trust the tech companies.
sentences.zh: 人们不信任科技公司。

sentences.en: The antipathy towards AI in particular is high, but the tech companies and a bunch of billionaires own all our distribution in very significant and serious ways.
sentences.zh: 人们对人工智能的反感尤其强烈，但科技公司和一群亿万富翁以非常重要和严肃的方式拥有我们所有的分配。

sentences.en: Something is going to happen.
sentences.zh: 有事要发生了。

sentences.en: The audiences are going to change in some way.
sentences.zh: 观众将会以某种方式发生变化。

sentences.en: There will be some reaction somehow.
sentences.zh: 或多或少都会有一些反应。

sentences.en: Do you have a view of that?
sentences.zh: 您对此有看法吗？

blocks.html_en: This stuff keeps changing. There is a temptation to validate the populist impulses of the moment that I actually think journalists should probably resist sometimes. I heard your interview with Gaby Del Valle about data center politics. I loved her anecdote about a rumor going around that the data centers were killing cattle, and she tracked it down to one Texas farmer who had lost one cow.

sentences.en: This stuff keeps changing.
sentences.zh: 这些东西一直在变化。

sentences.en: There is a temptation to validate the populist impulses of the moment that I actually think journalists should probably resist sometimes.
sentences.zh: 目前存在着一种验证民粹主义冲动的诱惑，我实际上认为记者有时应该抵制这种诱惑。

sentences.en: I heard your interview with Gaby Del Valle about data center politics.
sentences.zh: 我听到了您对 Gaby Del Valle 关于数据中心政治的采访。

sentences.en: I loved her anecdote about a rumor going around that the data centers were killing cattle, and she tracked it down to one Texas farmer who had lost one cow.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢她的轶事，关于数据中心正在宰杀牛的谣言，她追踪到一位德克萨斯州农民失去了一头牛。

blocks.html_en: I actually think the role of journalism is not always to amplify the populist reaction, even though it’s so easy and social media validates that. It’s a little more complicated. I actually hesitate to predict whether things are getting better or worse.

sentences.en: I actually think the role of journalism is not always to amplify the populist reaction, even though it’s so easy and social media validates that.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为新闻的作用并不总是放大民粹主义反应，尽管这很容易，而且社交媒体也证实了这一点。

sentences.en: It’s a little more complicated.
sentences.zh: 有点复杂。

sentences.en: I actually hesitate to predict whether things are getting better or worse.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我对于预测事情是变得更好还是更糟感到犹豫。

blocks.html_en: Your event Silicon Valley & The World is coming up. If I had to make one prediction about the midterms, it would be that surveillance and data centers will cause some sort of left-right realignment. They scramble the lines in very populist ways.

sentences.en: Your event Silicon Valley & The World is coming up.
sentences.zh: 您的活动《硅谷与世界》即将举行。

sentences.en: If I had to make one prediction about the midterms, it would be that surveillance and data centers will cause some sort of left-right realignment.
sentences.zh: 如果我必须对中期选举做出一个预测，那就是监控和数据中心将导致某种左右的重新调整。

sentences.en: They scramble the lines in very populist ways.
sentences.zh: 他们以非常民粹主义的方式扰乱界限。

blocks.html_en: But they also cause alignment. They bring together very disparate groups of people. How do you expect that class of billionaires, which all want things, to react to what I feel like will be a surprising story in the midterms?

sentences.en: But they also cause alignment.
sentences.zh: 但它们也会导致对齐。

sentences.en: They bring together very disparate groups of people.
sentences.zh: 他们将截然不同的人群聚集在一起。

sentences.en: How do you expect that class of billionaires, which all want things, to react to what I feel like will be a surprising story in the midterms?
sentences.zh: 你期望那些都想要东西的亿万富翁阶层对我认为中期选举中令人惊讶的故事有何反应？

blocks.html_en: There are different strains of this. The data center story is so hot right now, and I’m in the minority here. Most people think this will be a huge political issue for a long time. Companies try to build facilities in people’s neighborhoods and then they go in and they sponsor the Little League team and they pay a bunch of carpenters and they sponsor the parade. That is actually something corporate America is pretty good at. And it’s unbelievable how badly they screwed this up, these data centers.

sentences.en: There are different strains of this.
sentences.zh: 这有不同的变种。

sentences.en: The data center story is so hot right now, and I’m in the minority here.
sentences.zh: 数据中心的故事现在非常热门，而我是这里的少数派。

sentences.en: Most people think this will be a huge political issue for a long time.
sentences.zh: 大多数人认为这将是一个长期的巨大政治问题。

sentences.en: Companies try to build facilities in people’s neighborhoods and then they go in and they sponsor the Little League team and they pay a bunch of carpenters and they sponsor the parade.
sentences.zh: 公司试图在人们的社区建造设施，然后他们进去赞助少年棒球联盟球队，他们付钱给一群木匠，他们赞助游行。

sentences.en: That is actually something corporate America is pretty good at.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是美国企业界非常擅长的事情。

sentences.en: And it’s unbelievable how badly they screwed this up, these data centers.
sentences.zh: 令人难以置信的是，他们把这些数据中心搞砸了有多严重。

blocks.html_en: Yeah, it’s very bad.

sentences.en: Yeah, it’s very bad.
sentences.zh: 是的，这很糟糕。

blocks.html_en: But that is because they aren’t actually causing stillborn cattle. Fundamentally, with the exception that they’re going to have to navigate the energy issue, they’re going to have to find a way to not elevate energy prices. But some of that probably does fade as companies figure out how to do this without infuriating neighborhoods and doing it in places people want it. Maybe it will become less of an issue.

sentences.en: But that is because they aren’t actually causing stillborn cattle.
sentences.zh: 但这是因为它们实际上并没有导致牛死产。

sentences.en: Fundamentally, with the exception that they’re going to have to navigate the energy issue, they’re going to have to find a way to not elevate energy prices.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，除了他们必须解决能源问题外，他们还必须找到一种不抬高能源价格的方法。

sentences.en: But some of that probably does fade as companies figure out how to do this without infuriating neighborhoods and doing it in places people want it.
sentences.zh: 但随着公司弄清楚如何在不激怒社区的情况下做到这一点，并在人们想要的地方这样做，其中一些可能确实会消失。

sentences.en: Maybe it will become less of an issue.
sentences.zh: 也许它会变得不再是一个问题。

blocks.html_en: The big questions around regulating AI are just fascinating. And you’re right, after, as you said, not regulating social media and then beginning the [second] Trump administration with this incredibly accelerationist point of view, they are now just doing it. They’re just regulating this technology day to day. They’re going to have to figure out a framework for it. Every political candidate will have to have some point of view on it.

sentences.en: The big questions around regulating AI are just fascinating.
sentences.zh: 围绕人工智能监管的重大问题非常有趣。

sentences.en: And you’re right, after, as you said, not regulating social media and then beginning the [second] Trump administration with this incredibly accelerationist point of view, they are now just doing it.
sentences.zh: 你是对的，正如你所说，在不对社交媒体进行监管，然后以这种令人难以置信的加速主义观点开始第二届特朗普政府之后，他们现在正在这样做。

sentences.en: They’re just regulating this technology day to day.
sentences.zh: 他们只是每天规范这项技术。

sentences.en: They’re going to have to figure out a framework for it.
sentences.zh: 他们必须找出一个框架。

sentences.en: Every political candidate will have to have some point of view on it.
sentences.zh: 每个政治候选人都必须对此有一些观点。

blocks.html_en: It’s pretty unpredictable what this is going to be, but I do think we’re in a new era. Particularly the biggest part of the new era is just that the federal government is now this huge participant in the economy and in the economy of tech. It owns a big chunk of intel and is trying to shape technological policies and picking winners and losers. Executives are in Washington constantly trying to make their case. I think that whoever the next president is, that probably doesn’t change. And that’s a really massive structural shift that we’re all going to be covering.

sentences.en: It’s pretty unpredictable what this is going to be, but I do think we’re in a new era.
sentences.zh: 未来会发生什么是很难预测的，但我确实认为我们正处于一个新时代。

sentences.en: Particularly the biggest part of the new era is just that the federal government is now this huge participant in the economy and in the economy of tech.
sentences.zh: 新时代最重要的部分是联邦政府现在是经济和科技经济的巨大参与者。

sentences.en: It owns a big chunk of intel and is trying to shape technological policies and picking winners and losers.
sentences.zh: 它拥有大量情报，并试图制定技术政策并挑选赢家和输家。

sentences.en: Executives are in Washington constantly trying to make their case.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿的高管们不断地试图阐明自己的观点。

sentences.en: I think that whoever the next president is, that probably doesn’t change.
sentences.zh: 我认为无论下一任总统是谁，这可能都不会改变。

sentences.en: And that’s a really massive structural shift that we’re all going to be covering.
sentences.zh: 这是我们都将要讨论的一个非常巨大的结构性转变。

blocks.html_en: Do you think that you can run as a populist if you want to take a big stake in our AI companies? Or is that a redistributive move?

sentences.en: Do you think that you can run as a populist if you want to take a big stake in our AI companies?
sentences.zh: 你认为如果你想持有我们人工智能公司的大量股份，你可以作为民粹主义者参选吗？

sentences.en: Or is that a redistributive move?
sentences.zh: 或者说这是一种再分配举措？

blocks.html_en: I don’t think populism is necessarily that. I wouldn’t get too far into the details. It just depends how you talk about it.

sentences.en: I don’t think populism is necessarily that.
sentences.zh: 我认为民粹主义不一定是这样。

sentences.en: I wouldn’t get too far into the details.
sentences.zh: 我不会透露太多细节。

sentences.en: It just depends how you talk about it.
sentences.zh: 这只是取决于你如何谈论它。

blocks.html_en: That does seem like the theme of the day in Washington.

sentences.en: That does seem like the theme of the day in Washington.
sentences.zh: 这似乎确实是华盛顿今天的主题。

blocks.html_en: What do they say about simple solutions to complex problems?

sentences.en: What do they say about simple solutions to complex problems?
sentences.zh: 他们对复杂问题的简单解决方案有何看法？

blocks.html_en: Yeah, Trump has compared those stakes in companies to the sovereign wealth funds.

sentences.en: Yeah, Trump has compared those stakes in companies to the sovereign wealth funds.
sentences.zh: 是的，特朗普将公司的这些股份与主权财富基金进行了比较。

blocks.html_en: Yeah, that’s reasonable.

sentences.en: Yeah, that’s reasonable.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是合理的。

blocks.html_en: A lot of Gulf states have that. I actually wanted to ask you about this. You cover the Gulf deeply, you’ve got events in the Gulf. The United States, I would say, is in some kind of free speech crisis that is modeled a lot after the control that Gulf states have over their media and what people are not allowed to say. The Kushner family is all wrapped up into that.

sentences.en: A lot of Gulf states have that.
sentences.zh: 许多海湾国家都有这样的情况。

sentences.en: I actually wanted to ask you about this.
sentences.zh: 我其实想问你这个问题。

sentences.en: You cover the Gulf deeply, you’ve got events in the Gulf.
sentences.zh: 你深入报道了海湾地区，你在海湾地区发生了一些事件。

sentences.en: The United States, I would say, is in some kind of free speech crisis that is modeled a lot after the control that Gulf states have over their media and what people are not allowed to say.
sentences.zh: 我想说，美国正处于某种言论自由危机之中，这种危机很大程度上模仿了海湾国家对其媒体的控制以及人们不被允许发表的言论。

sentences.en: The Kushner family is all wrapped up into that.
sentences.zh: 库什纳家族全都陷入其中。

blocks.html_en: How do you think about all of the things you talked about independence when you have that money in your organization, when you have those folks on your various boards at events, when you have journalists on the ground in those places?

sentences.en: How do you think about all of the things you talked about independence when you have that money in your organization, when you have those folks on your various boards at events, when you have journalists on the ground in those places?
sentences.zh: 当你的组织里有那么多钱，当你在活动的各个董事会中都有这些人，当你在这些地方有记者时，你如何看待你谈到的所有关于独立的事情？

blocks.html_en: We cover Saudi and the Emirates in particular a lot and pretty aggressively. We hired the great reporters from Bloomberg and The Wall Street Journal and places like that in the region. We don’t have any investment money from the Gulf and for many sovereigns. I’m not sure that’s what you meant, but just to be clear about that.

sentences.en: We cover Saudi and the Emirates in particular a lot and pretty aggressively.
sentences.zh: 我们特别频繁且积极地报道沙特阿拉伯和阿联酋。

sentences.en: We hired the great reporters from Bloomberg and The Wall Street Journal and places like that in the region.
sentences.zh: 我们聘请了来自彭博社和《华尔街日报》以及该地区类似机构的优秀记者。

sentences.en: We don’t have any investment money from the Gulf and for many sovereigns.
sentences.zh: 我们没有来自海湾地区和许多主权国家的任何投资资金。

sentences.en: I’m not sure that’s what you meant, but just to be clear about that.
sentences.zh: 我不确定这就是你的意思，但只是为了澄清这一点。

blocks.html_en: They’re on your board for these events.

sentences.en: They’re on your board for these events.
sentences.zh: 他们是这些活动的董事会成员。

blocks.html_en: They’re advisors. There are some executives from that part of the world on advisory boards. But we cover them independently. The same as the Financial Times and The Wall Street Journal and others do in that region, and in The New York Times. If you talk to reporters who work in the region, it’s very, very hard and complicated. And there are local laws that you have to be careful about.

sentences.en: They’re advisors.
sentences.zh: 他们是顾问。

sentences.en: There are some executives from that part of the world on advisory boards.
sentences.zh: 顾问委员会中有一些来自该地区的高管。

sentences.en: But we cover them independently.
sentences.zh: 但我们独立报道它们。

sentences.en: The same as the Financial Times and The Wall Street Journal and others do in that region, and in The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 就像《金融时报》、《华尔街日报》和其他报纸在该地区以及《纽约时报》所做的那样。

sentences.en: If you talk to reporters who work in the region, it’s very, very hard and complicated.
sentences.zh: 如果你与在该地区工作的记者交谈，你会发现这是非常非常困难和复杂的。

sentences.en: And there are local laws that you have to be careful about.
sentences.zh: 您必须注意当地的法律。

blocks.html_en: We were the only ones to write about a very interesting story, the way in which the Emirates, I believe, were preventing photojournalists from distributing images. That’s just the law. If your photographer goes and takes a picture of a drone that hit a building, they will arrest them. Every news organization that operates in that region, that operates in China, you just have to be really, really careful and thoughtful about it, but you can’t let it compromise the reporting.

sentences.en: We were the only ones to write about a very interesting story, the way in which the Emirates, I believe, were preventing photojournalists from distributing images.
sentences.zh: 我们是唯一写了一个非常有趣的故事的人，我相信阿联酋航空阻止摄影记者分发图像的方式。

sentences.en: That’s just the law.
sentences.zh: 这就是法律。

sentences.en: If your photographer goes and takes a picture of a drone that hit a building, they will arrest them.
sentences.zh: 如果你的摄影师去拍摄一架撞到建筑物的无人机的照片，他们会逮捕他们。

sentences.en: Every news organization that operates in that region, that operates in China, you just have to be really, really careful and thoughtful about it, but you can’t let it compromise the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个在该地区、在中国运营的新闻机构，你都必须非常非常小心和深思熟虑，但你不能让它影响报道。

blocks.html_en: Do you feel like it compromises the reporting here in the United States?

sentences.en: Do you feel like it compromises the reporting here in the United States?
sentences.zh: 您觉得这会损害美国的报道吗？

blocks.html_en: No. I think that global news organizations actually — and if you think about The New York Times, which has reporters in Tehran — have thought really hard about this. There are stories that you have your correspondent in Washington write that you wouldn’t have somebody on the ground in Tehran write. And obviously, we think a lot about the safety of our reporters, but it’s a complicated question.

sentences.en: No. I think that global news organizations actually — and if you think about The New York Times, which has reporters in Tehran — have thought really hard about this.
sentences.zh: 不。我认为全球新闻机构实际上——如果你想想在德黑兰有记者的《纽约时报》——已经认真思考过这个问题。

sentences.en: There are stories that you have your correspondent in Washington write that you wouldn’t have somebody on the ground in Tehran write.
sentences.zh: 有些故事是你让驻华盛顿的记者写的，但你不会让德黑兰当地的人来写。

sentences.en: And obviously, we think a lot about the safety of our reporters, but it’s a complicated question.
sentences.zh: 显然，我们对记者的安全考虑很多，但这是一个复杂的问题。

blocks.html_en: I asked that question because I see what the Trump administration does to journalists here.

sentences.en: I asked that question because I see what the Trump administration does to journalists here.
sentences.zh: 我问这个问题是因为我看到特朗普政府对记者所做的事情。

blocks.html_en: It’s funny, because I think that we obviously are in this, as you said, free speech crisis here in all sorts of ways. I don’t think it’s like a monarchy that doesn’t have the First Amendment. I think we’re a long way from that.

sentences.en: It’s funny, because I think that we obviously are in this, as you said, free speech crisis here in all sorts of ways.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣，因为我认为我们显然以各种方式陷入了这场言论自由危机。

sentences.en: I don’t think it’s like a monarchy that doesn’t have the First Amendment.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这就像没有第一修正案的君主制。

sentences.en: I think we’re a long way from that.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们离这个目标还有很长的路要走。

blocks.html_en: To me, the closer parallel to the Gulf is personalist rule. People talk a lot about corruption, but when you think about these relationships, often it’s a totally different style of doing business where you’re helping your friends and family. But it’s like a totally different modality that obviously in the American tradition is incredibly corrupt. In other parts of the world, that’s just the nature of business. I think that’s how parts of the Trump administration operate.

sentences.en: To me, the closer parallel to the Gulf is personalist rule.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，与海湾更接近的是个人主义统治。

sentences.en: People talk a lot about corruption, but when you think about these relationships, often it’s a totally different style of doing business where you’re helping your friends and family.
sentences.zh: 人们经常谈论腐败，但当你思考这些关系时，你会发现这是一种完全不同的做生意方式，你在帮助你的朋友和家人。

sentences.en: But it’s like a totally different modality that obviously in the American tradition is incredibly corrupt.
sentences.zh: 但这就像一种完全不同的方式，在美国传统中显然是极其腐败的。

sentences.en: In other parts of the world, that’s just the nature of business.
sentences.zh: 在世界其他地方，这就是商业的本质。

sentences.en: I think that’s how parts of the Trump administration operate.
sentences.zh: 我认为这就是特朗普政府部分部门的运作方式。

blocks.html_en: The Trump family in particular sees that as a model. That was the comparison I was making. You can see them enriching themselves, particularly in that part of the world.

sentences.en: The Trump family in particular sees that as a model.
sentences.zh: 特朗普家族尤其将其视为典范。

sentences.en: That was the comparison I was making.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所做的比较。

sentences.en: You can see them enriching themselves, particularly in that part of the world.

content_html_zh:
今天我要采访的是 Semafor 的主编 Ben Smith。

无论你走到哪里，人们都会说他们不信任媒体——但他们对媒体的了解却从未如此之多。 受众已经从传统名称转向 Substacks、播客和 TikTok 新闻影响者，这些在我们的提要中似乎无处不在。

为什么有人想在这一切之中建立一个新的全球新闻机构，即使是像哥伦比亚广播公司新闻这样的曾经的传奇品牌似乎也无法弄清楚这一点？

嗯，这就是本四年前所做的。 他是在 Facebook 流量繁荣时期运营 BuzzFeed News 的人，甚至还写了一本关于 BuzzFeed News 的书，名为《Traffic》，早在 2023 年他就在 Decoder 上与我讨论过这本书。

Verge 订阅者，不要忘记，无论您在何处获取播客，都可以获得无广告解码器的独占访问权限。 前往这里。 还不是订阅者？ 您可以在这里注册。

大约在同一时间，他与​​他人共同创立了 Semafor，该网站于 2022 年推出，其既定目标是覆盖 2 亿受过大学教育的读者。

你会听到 Ben 说，从那时起，Semafor 已经发展成为他所说的一家反规模公司。 它仍然没有网站付费专区，但它大约有一半的收入来自召集业务——这就是媒体类型最近在召集活动上采取的做法。

Semafor 举办了一些大型活动。 实际上，它有一个名为“硅谷与世界”的新项目，其中将包括一些科技和人工智能领域的知名人士。 这是活动业务的一部分：在大型活动舞台上举办您涵盖的主题。

所以我想知道这一切是如何运作的，以及应对目前媒体中似乎无处不在的道德冲突是什么感觉。 我特别想深入了解 Semafor 的新闻编辑室如何对待人工智能、将您报道的人员纳入会议顾问委员会的道德和观点，以及观众是否仍然愿意为独立性付费。

本和我通常会一边喝啤酒一边讨论这些问题，我想你可以看出我们真的很喜欢一起讨论这一切。

好的：Semafor 主编 Ben Smith。 开始了。

为了篇幅和清晰度，本文字记录经过了轻微编辑。

Ben Smith，您是 Semafor 的联合创始人兼主编。 欢迎回到解码器。

回来真是太好了。

我很高兴能和你说话。 三年前，当 Semafor 推出时，您就参加了这个节目。 恰逢您创立并经营了很长时间的 Buzzfeed News 即将关闭。

我一直在与媒体首席执行官谈论即将发生的事情。 感觉就像你在 Semafor 找到了一些东西。 那边情况怎么样？

事情进展得非常顺利，正如我所说的那样，但我认为我们已经找到了一些办法。 有很多不同的事情需要弄清楚，我们正处于媒体这个令人难以置信的奇怪和不稳定的时刻。

但我确实认为我们已经找到了一种模式，即围绕伟大的记者建立高质量的新闻业，并与真正大规模的会议相结合，既建立了伟大的新闻业，又建立了一个真正好的企业，一个有利可图的企业——对于我作为一名前 BuzzFeed 高管来说，这是一种新颖的东西。

如今，盈利的数字媒体业务供不应求。 有趣的是，我正在回顾我们三年前的谈话。 您刚刚出版了《流量》一书，这本书基本上是关于我所说的千禧年数字媒体时刻和每个人都在追求大规模的内容。

“这些平台将为我们带来大量流量，然后我们就能赚到钱，然后我们都会变得富有。” 这是一个很常见的论点。 感觉就像你在说你已经放弃了这一点。 你已经吸取了那次的教训。

我们的首席营收官雷切尔·奥本海姆 (Rachel Oppenheim) 喜欢开玩笑说我的下一本书将被称为《No Traffic》，但我们实际上正在建立一项反规模业务。 在交通灾难的废墟中，在那一刻出发的奢侈，显然不是成功之路。

我们必须认真思考如何定位和建立非常特定的受众群体。 在所有这些谈话中我逐渐意识到的事情...... 我听你的节目。 我们有一个关于媒体的节目，我们在节目中对此大喊大叫。 自媒体的未来是什么？ 是直播吗？ 我们只是在谈论它。 谁知道？

但在新闻业，我坚信伟大的故事不会消失。 对高质量洞察力的需求不会消失。 伟大的记者哪儿也不去。 这一切赖以生存的表面是什么，都是有待争夺的，你不能对此抱有太多的意识形态。

你说表面，我总是说分布。

Yeah.

我们一遍又一遍地回顾 Decoder 的一个主题是，你的分布决定了你所做的事情。 这是不可避免的。 借用这个框架，媒介就是信息。 如果表面（如果是分布）可供争夺，那么您会抓住什么？

在某种程度上，因为您处于小工具评论空间，所以您可以清楚地看到它。 我认为这在每个空间都是如此。 新闻业的核心以及它的有趣之处在于它的对抗性以及你所提问的人、你所报道的人的独立性和独立性。 像广告这样的企业会让事情变得复杂，但如果你不保持这种独立性，你就会泄露整个故事。

我们着迷地思考这个问题。 对于喜欢创新的企业来说，道德领域非常重要，以至于你实际上不想创新。 这是一个没有人应该创新的领域，或者你应该非常非常小心，因为如果你思考为什么营销会议如此无聊，那是因为他们没有对人们进行艰难的独立采访。 我们的活动很有趣，因为我们正在进行艰难的独立采访，而泄露这些将是一个巨大的错误。

我可以问你一个非常直接的问题吗？

你们正在举办《硅谷与世界》，这是一场大型的新会议。 这是你说你要与达沃斯竞争。 你将举办一系列这样的会议，在最大的舞台上竞争。 正如我听说的，你正在召集人们。

如果你看看《纽约时报》和《华尔街日报》以及我们的其他竞争对手（例如彭博社）的做法，就会发现围绕这些活动建立社区并激发人们的兴奋感的一部分就是以某种方式将你将采访的新闻人物拉入活动。 《纽约时报》称他们为特别工作组。 《华尔街日报》称他们为理事会。 彭博社实际上也称他们为顾问委员会。 但新闻业完全独立于他们。

但这是如何运作的呢？ 我参加了代码会议，我记得我当时想，“我真的需要让某某首席执行官出现在舞台上。” 如果在他们登上飞机前往加利福尼亚州的前一天，我们会说：“某某的首席执行官非常腐败。 这是我们为期八个月的调查……”

他们可能会取消您的预订。

他们可能会取消。 我想：“那就没问题了。 实际上那就太好了。”

是的，完全可以。

因为我会上台说：“他们取消了，因为他们无法接受。” 但同时，我知道买票的人可能是为了看某某上台而买票。 这实际上从未达到紧要关头。 这实际上从来都不是问题。 它一直在我的脑海里。

也许你没有做足够的曝光。

我想，“我应该更多地制造这个问题吗？” 您对此有何看法？ 您对这些公司的报道水平非常高。

显然我们总是写他们不喜欢的故事。 我们非常非常努力地做到公平。 我们尽量不让人们陷入沙袋，但有两件不同的事情。 一是，“你是否写了一个让他们不高兴的故事，然后他们取消了你的计划？” 你只需要愿意。 这只是新闻业的经营成本，这种情况将会发生，而你根本无法想象。 我们正在努力变得成熟和公平。

各种传播人士总是问我：“为什么首席执行官们要来参加这个节目？” 在我们的 YouTube 评论中，人们会问：“他们为什么会出现？” 我最常得到的答案是，这是他们自己的员工倾听他们意见的唯一方式。

他们希望看到你所描述的挑战、利害关系和冲突以这种形式出现，而没有人倾听全体成员的意见。

并且不这样做。

-并且压制大型科技公司却无所作为，我们从未在这个国家通过隐私法。

你看，“这些家伙是怪物，我们可以向他们扔棍子和石头。” 另一方面，他们拥有分销渠道。 他们在X上，做任何他们想做的事。 有一种感觉，他们不需要责任。

马克·扎克伯格刚刚发表了一份 6,500 字的宣言，我认为这是大一时的政治科学思考。 他会侥幸逃脱惩罚，因为他周围几乎没有人会说：“试着变得比这更聪明。”

您是否在您的活动中看到了这种联系，您需要挑战其中一些高管的事情是人们认为您的价值观不好，而不是您的业务决策？

当你采访某人时，如果有人对他们正在做的事情提出核心批评，那就是价值观，你一定要问。 你总是问他们。 这也是他们一直在思考的问题。

不过，我实际上不同意你对人工智能首席执行官的看法。 我们正在走出一个拥有商业领袖的时代。 马克·安德森（Marc Andreessen）是这方面的零号病人——非常非常聪明的人，非常有影响力，影响了很多人以这种方式思考，但他对媒体有一种深深的偏执，觉得它不相关。

如果你看看这个时代真正伟大的商业人物，或者新的商业人物——我会说达里奥·阿莫迪、山姆·奥尔特曼和黄仁勋——他们都是热爱媒体的经典表演者。 或者我不知道他们是喜欢媒体还是讨厌媒体，但他们像史蒂夫·乔布斯一样理解媒体，就像唐纳德·特朗普一样。

他们在卖东西。

他们是销售人员，将媒体视为非常重要的销售渠道，这也是企业领导者一直以来的态度。 他们在那些偏执的男人和女人周围跑来跑去，说：“我不知道我们是否可以和这位记者谈谈。”

他们只要拿起电话，就登上封面，穿着皮夹克，做任何有点老套但非常有效的《时代》杂志封面风格的事情。 显然，传统媒体正在减少，并且出现了新的渠道，但从根本上来说，他们只是表演者，他们并没有与他们计划改变的媒体建立某种深厚的理论关系。

和许多人一样，埃隆显然是这条规则的一个大例外，但新一代商界领袖的其他人与媒体的关系要正常得多。

我认为在这种背景下真正有趣的事情之一是新闻创造者、新闻影响者的崛起，他们不像你那样属于机器。 他们没有像贾斯汀·史密斯那样说：“我建立了一个全球新闻机构。 你只要做出色的报道，我就会找到新的业务。 顺便说一句，所有大印刷报纸都有特别工作组。 我们将召开一次全球会议并解决独立问题。”

我采访过的影响者和创作者，这都是他们的第一印象。 他们感觉到，他们可以得到礼物或机会，或者让自己看起来更重要。

他们在深层次上与之斗争。 我们的许多实业家和政治家现在都明白，这是获得更多受众的更快途径，而且对内容和社论的影响力更大。 你如何与之竞争？

你必须有勇气相信人们想要新闻业，人们实际上喜欢真实的事实而不是谎言，喜欢独立的声音而不是腐败的声音。 这是一个非常乐观的观点，但大体上是正确的。 你会看到最有趣、最成功的创作者也发现了这一点。

伟大的硅谷播客 Dwarkesh Patel 的问题变得越来越棘手，因为他非常老练，我认为他意识到他的观众知道，如果你采访黄仁勋关于他如何看待中国的芯片，你应该问他困难的问题，而不是简单的问题，这更有趣。 太明显了。 对于那些钦佩或担心创作者的记者来说，有些人缺乏勇气，坚信提出困难的问题比简单的问题更有趣。

你不需要那个人出现来接受提问吗？ 这就是我在很多地方看到的动态。 对于播客和创作者来说，他们学到的是他们的观众是持久的。 你不需要名人。 您不需要 Apple 访问权限即可吸引大量受众。 如果你有很多观众，你就可以做任何你想做的事。 我的表述是，您需要的访问权限越少，获得的权限就越多。 但这是一开始就很难学到的教训。

有句老话说，访问也是一种诅咒。

哦，访问是有毒的。

我非常密切地关注政治，你在华盛顿也能看到这一点。 我不知道你是否还记得，在特朗普执政之初，白宫新闻发布会上所有这些有影响力的人物都询问卡罗琳·莱维特如何打理头发。 问题是，我认为他们和他们的观众发现这非常无聊，他们就走开去谈论与坎迪斯·欧文斯或其他人进行偏执的战斗。

同样，五角大楼特别引入了所有他们认为是盟友、灵活的右翼影响者来取代令人讨厌的主流媒体。 然后当伊朗战争开始时，Gateway Pundit 就战争问题盘问 Pete Hegseth，他没有答案，因为吸引观众有很多有毒的东西，你可能会被你的观众拉到各种疯狂的地方，但你也可能会被你的观众拉向新闻业。

你在五角大楼新闻发布室看到的是，他们的观众对战争感到紧张并且不喜欢它。 突然之间，皮特·赫格斯 (Pete Hegseth) 遭到了这些宠物店的盘问，他之所以把这些宠物店放在那里是为了避免处理真正的问题。 从某种意义上说，新闻业并不是你在新闻学校学到的一门职业。 这实际上是为你的观众提供的一项服务，任何人都可以知道你是否在关注。

对我来说，关于这种动态的真正有趣的事情之一，特别是在五角大楼，他们派驻在那里的许多记者首先是视频。 他们正在制作剪辑。 我可以在新闻发布会上看到他们试图获取剪辑。 他们知道视频会播放，然后平台会奖励冲突，评论是：“你为什么问这个问题？”

您认为 20 世纪 80 年代萨姆·唐纳森 (Sam Donaldson) 在白宫新闻发布室做什么？ 这些都是表演的阶段。

当然。 是谁？ Newt Gingrich 发现 C-SPAN 是他的舞台。 我理解，但尤其是剪辑经济。

他们要制作一个剪辑，也许是观众把你拉向新闻业，或者也许只是算法把你拉向冲突。

当然，有好的拉力，也有坏的拉力。

有时很难区分。 你现在正在制作更多的视频，而这正是 Semaform 的目的是揭露新闻业的结构，因为它的观众非常聪明，其中一些是首席执行官。 然后你将去视频平台上制作视频，你将体验到其他的吸引力。 您如何看待管理这个问题？ 你不追求规模吗？

不，我们想了很多，关于不追求视频的规模，而是尝试进行真正的高层对话。 在媒体或我们的商业节目《复利》中，有大量（但不是最大的）观众愿意与领导者进行真正复杂的对话；我们的首席执行官信号节目中的首席执行官；以及我们将要推出的其他东西。

视频让我想起了社交网络，以及如果你跟随它走向其他人也在走向的固定点，就会感受到无限规模的诱惑。 这就是令人难以置信的同质化力量。 本周，左翼人士都对巴里·韦斯表示愤怒，而且党派之争非常非常强烈。 不，我们只是进行了很多关于抵制这种行为的内部对话。
